package project

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationdeleteproduct/blog"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

type relationFacadeAuthorToken struct{}

type BlogPostRelationFacadeSelectors struct {
	Author relationFacadeAuthorToken
}

type BlogPostFacadeQuery struct {
	Related       BlogPostRelationFacadeSelectors
	spikeBackend  db.Queryer
	spikeFactory  BlogPostObjectFactory
	spikeQuerySet orm.QuerySet[blog.Post]
}

type BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery struct {
	spikeFactory  BlogPostObjectFactory
	spikeQuerySet orm.QuerySet[blog.Post]
}

type Models struct {
	BlogPosts BlogPostFacadeQuery
}

func Using(backend db.Queryer) (Models, error) {
	objects, err := BindObjects()
	if err != nil {
		return Models{}, err
	}
	return Models{
		BlogPosts: BlogPostFacadeQuery{
			Related:       BlogPostRelationFacadeSelectors{},
			spikeBackend:  backend,
			spikeFactory:  objects.BlogPost,
			spikeQuerySet: blog.PostObjects.Using(backend),
		},
	}, nil
}

func (query BlogPostFacadeQuery) Filter(predicates ...orm.Predicate[blog.Post]) BlogPostFacadeQuery {
	query.spikeQuerySet = query.spikeQuerySet.Filter(predicates...)
	return query
}

func (query BlogPostFacadeQuery) OrderBy(orderings ...orm.Ordering[blog.Post]) BlogPostFacadeQuery {
	query.spikeQuerySet = query.spikeQuerySet.OrderBy(orderings...)
	return query
}

func (query BlogPostFacadeQuery) Limit(limit int) (BlogPostFacadeQuery, error) {
	limited, err := query.spikeQuerySet.Limit(limit)
	if err != nil {
		return BlogPostFacadeQuery{}, err
	}
	query.spikeQuerySet = limited
	return query, nil
}

func (query BlogPostFacadeQuery) First(ctx context.Context) (*BlogPostObject, bool, error) {
	value, found, err := query.spikeQuerySet.First(ctx)
	if err != nil || !found {
		return nil, found, err
	}
	object, err := query.spikeFactory.From(query.spikeBackend, value)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}
	return object, true, nil
}

func (query BlogPostFacadeQuery) All(ctx context.Context) ([]*BlogPostObject, error) {
	values, err := query.spikeQuerySet.All(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	objects := make([]*BlogPostObject, len(values))
	for index := range values {
		object, err := query.spikeFactory.From(query.spikeBackend, values[index])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		objects[index] = object
	}
	return objects, nil
}

func (query BlogPostFacadeQuery) SelectRelated(relationFacadeAuthorToken) BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery {
	return BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery{
		spikeFactory:  query.spikeFactory,
		spikeQuerySet: query.spikeQuerySet,
	}
}

func (query BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery) Filter(predicates ...orm.Predicate[blog.Post]) BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery {
	query.spikeQuerySet = query.spikeQuerySet.Filter(predicates...)
	return query
}

func (query BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery) OrderBy(orderings ...orm.Ordering[blog.Post]) BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery {
	query.spikeQuerySet = query.spikeQuerySet.OrderBy(orderings...)
	return query
}

func (query BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery) Limit(limit int) (BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery, error) {
	limited, err := query.spikeQuerySet.Limit(limit)
	if err != nil {
		return BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery{}, err
	}
	query.spikeQuerySet = limited
	return query, nil
}

func (query BlogPostAuthorFacadeQuery) All(ctx context.Context) ([]*BlogPostObject, error) {
	return query.spikeFactory.SelectRelated(query.spikeQuerySet).Author().All(ctx)
}
